findings.title: Readyset did not answer SHOW CACHES.

actions.label: Clear proxied queries…
actions.description: Clears Readyset's catalog of observed uncached proxied queries; active caches are untouched.

actions.label: Enter maintenance mode…
actions.description: Sets Readyset's status to Maintenance Mode, a signal for tools such as ProxySQL to stop sending queries.

actions.label: Exit maintenance mode…
actions.description: Clears the Maintenance Mode status signal.
actions.why_not: Readyset is not in maintenance mode.
actions.fix: Only a server in maintenance mode can exit it.

actions.label: Start replication…
actions.description: Resumes ingesting binlog changes from the upstream CDC server.
actions.fix: Only stopped replication can be started.

actions.label: Stop replication…
actions.description: Pauses ingesting binlog changes from the upstream CDC server; deep caches stop receiving updates.

actions.label: Set replication position…
actions.description: Sets the upstream binlog or GTID position from which Readyset's replicator resumes.

actions.label: Add tables to replicate…
actions.description: Starts snapshotting and replicating the specified upstream base tables into Readyset.

actions.label: Set log level…
actions.description: Updates Readyset's runtime tracing filter immediately.

actions.label: Set eviction memory limit…
actions.description: Updates the runtime memory threshold at which Readyset evicts cached entries.

actions.label: Set eviction period…
actions.description: Sets how often Readyset runs its cache memory eviction sweep.

actions.label: Add shallow allowlist item…
actions.description: Lets automatic shallow cache creation accept queries that reference one function, variable or schema; explicit CREATE SHALLOW CACHE and query hints bypass the allowlists.

actions.label: Flush Readyset privileges…
actions.description: Refreshes Readyset's cached upstream user credentials and table ACLs immediately.

actions.label: Shut down Readyset…
actions.description: Stops the Readyset process cleanly.
actions.why_not: ALTER READYSET SHUTDOWN is accepted only on the Readyset admin SQL port (default 6036).
actions.fix: Connect to the Readyset admin SQL port (default 6036) to shut down Readyset.

actions.label: Shut down & reset snapshot…
actions.description: Stops the Readyset process and discards persistent snapshot state so the next start performs a full re-snapshot.
actions.why_not: ALTER READYSET SHUTDOWN is accepted only on the Readyset admin SQL port (default 6036).
actions.fix: Connect to the Readyset admin SQL port (default 6036) to shut down Readyset.
